lines.text: Your own memory palace is a place you know well — your home, your school, or the way you walk every day.
Choose ten or more stations, in the order you walk past them: the front door, the shoe rack, the sofa ...
Always walk the same way, in the same order. That order keeps your list in order.
To remember a list, leave one item at each station — and make it big, funny and moving.
A giant rocket is stuck in your front door. A guitar is playing itself on your shoe rack.
To remember, walk through your palace in your mind and look at each station.
You can have up to three palaces: your home, your school or office, and a route.
